newsitem.title: FINLAND: FINNISH GLOBAL $BOND AMONG BEST 96 DEALS - EUROMONEY.
newsitem.headline: FINNISH GLOBAL $BOND AMONG BEST 96 DEALS - EUROMONEY.

text.p: Finland's one billion dollar 10-year global bond issued in February was named among the 50 best deals of 1996 by Euromoney magazine in its annual IMF/World Bank issue received on Wednesday.
"The 10-year bond was completed at 36 basis points over and set a new benchmark. This may have been because of extensive pre-marketing, but the strong Finnish economy helped," Euromoney said.
"This bond, launched in February, represented the first global offering from an investment-grade (Finnish) government entity for 10 months," it noted.
Euromoney listed the Finnish $1 billion bond among global bond issues in 'The best of the rest' category.
Lead managers of the Finnish bond were Morgan Stanley, Merrill Lynch and Nomura.
